description: Byte-lock TREATY for the CBOR delta codec. A ZSet<int> encodes as DynamicValue.Array of [Int key, Int weight] pairs, then canonical CBOR (RFC 8949, DynamicValue.toCanonicalCbor). The 4 language ports (F#/C#/Rust/TS) MUST produce these exact bytes and decode them back to the same Z-set. Hex-in-JSON per the no-binary-in-proof-lineage rule. Keys: int; weights: int64. Pairs are key-sorted ascending (ZSet canonical order).
